notes.title: Lemuria: Lost in Space - full version available!
Lemuria: Lost in Space - full version available!
Lemuria: Lost in Space demo - update 1.0 - now available!
notes.content:
We have just published a new update - 1.0. This is a final demo version that is identical as full version of the game that will be available on March 17th. 

Here is the full list of fixes and changes:

 Fixed: many small bugs on many scenes.
 Fixed: final version of achivements.
 Fixed: balanced difficulty level.
 Fixed a few typos in in-game texts and hacking puzzles


Fasten your belts - we are starting the main expedition soon! Don't miss our start discount!

EJR Team

notes.title: New contest - Guess accent of our lectors and win a key!
notes.content:
Play demo and listen to voice-overs. What are accents of the rescue spaceship crew?
There are voices of:
- Operator
- Captain
- Main Engineer
- Doctor
What are theirs accents?

To make your choice easier we can say that: one of them uses English accent, two of them North American and one: Australian.

The first person who will write it correctly, in discussion thread, will receive a key for full version of Lemura: Lost in space. 

Contest discussion thread:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/563250/discussions/0/133259227520658003/

notes.title: Lemuria: Lost in Space demo - update 0.8 - now available!
notes.content:
We are focusing on constantly improving Lemuria: Lost in Space experience. That's why we have just published a new update - 0.8. As always, we kindly ask you for your feedback - we constantly listen to our players while making changes the game better thanks to you.


Here is the full list of fixes and changes:

 New: Voice-overs are ready. We recorded all expedition crew members!
 New: Added new skill: Network hacking and new mini-game Netwar which allows you to bypass some tough fights with enemies. Now you can hack not only single Lemuria 7's computers but whole networks! Infect them with your viruses, unleash computer worms, perform DDOS attacks and take control over hostile central units.
 New: Made wrong skill-tree decisions? Now you can reset all character points and spend them in diffrent way, thanks to new item: a reset device.
 New: Want to make a clear screenshot? You can now disable GUI with F11 shortcut.
 Fixed: better controller support.
 Fixed: problem with targeting enemy in other location.
 Fixed: balanced difficulty level
 Fixed a few typos in in-game texts and hacking puzzles
 Fixed a lot of other small bugs and issues


Fasten your belts! We are starting the main expedition soon!

Enjoy the game and see you in the mysterious Lemuria 7 spaceship,
EJR Team

notes.title: Lemuria: Lost in Space demo - update 0.6 - now available!
notes.content:
Hello from Lemuria 7 Expedition HQ,

Our team is focusing on constantly improving Lemuria: Lost in Space experience, even for the free demo. That's why we have just published a new update - 0.6. As always, we kindly ask you for your feedback - we constantly listen to our players while making changes the game better thanks to you.


Here is the full list of fixes and changes:

    Fixed: Infinite loading screen between residential area and hibernators
    Fixed: The player sometimes was forced to enter a new room on the ship shortly after killing an encounter
    Fixed: The weapon switching not working properly when the first weapon that player found was the impulse pistol
    Fixed a few typos in in-game texts and hacking puzzles


We are currently working on the final missions in the game, so you may expect another game demo update closer to launch (still planned in Q1 2017).

Enjoy the game and see you in the mysterious Lemuria 7 spaceship,
EJR Team

notes.title: Lemuria: Lost in Space demo - update 0.4
notes.content:
Hello space explorers!

As we already started gathering feedback from a number of Lemuria: Lost in Space demo players, we made changes here and there and published 0.4 update for the game demo:


  the difficulty of easy and medium has been reduced – resources depleting has been slowed down and spare parts replenish energy at greater effect
  information about encounters is now displayed at greater distance
  ability to watch credits from the game menu has been added (in the footer)
  fix - survey loading after finishing guide instead of the game demo


Your feedback is crucial for us, so please spread the news about Lemuria: Lost in Space and remember about our hacking contest. All you need is to finish the game demo and write your idea about a puzzle for our hacking mini-game!

notes.title: The game demo is available now!
notes.content:
The game demo is available now on Steam for Windows! 


Please note that we are still polishing and adding new features to the Lemuria: Lost in Space:

  All of the voiceovers will be implemented at launch
  We are still balancing easy, medium and hard difficulty
  The game demo is about 20% of the main game
  After finishing the game demo, players will be redirected to survey about the game. The last question is part of the unique Lemuria Hacking Contest
